name: Snack Galaxy
lore: The road drifts up into a starry sky of donut planets and cheese moons, where snacks, kittens and the odd dinosaur float by at their own pace.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's 112 full story scenes, 50 picks and 17 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/02-snack-galaxy/README.md, 'Full story scenes'; picks-full.json). Kind painting (no outline: the other half of the ink-outline rule), thin line art stripped; each file is the whole stripped picture, converted by land.js boardOf with its chroma steps.

zen.note: v6 lane D7: Snack Galaxy plays as Zen World 3 (tools/land.js ... zen writes levels/zen.json only; levels.json, gallery.json, layout.json and config.json are not touched).

profile.note: Zen World 3, casual (v6 lane D7, 2026-10-08): Kitten Forest's casual profile as it ships (tools/lands/01-kitten-forest/land.json, carefulFloor included): tags E18/N26/H6/X0 ending on a Hard, light deck features, no locks, no archers, generous bands, no lookahead or careful ceilings. Plus organic moats (they arrive at Snack Galaxy), gentle only: a ring on a fifth of the Easy, two fifths of the Normal and two thirds of the Hard levels, always 2 ways in (opening set 0 front+far or 1 left+right), on pictures that can carry one. The 50 are lane C's full story scenes (painting kind, 42x42); the order is lane D's (tools/land-02-notes.md).

eggNote: Eggs on the painted side-quest spurs' tips (World 1's rule, eggsAt quests: the land has no side quests, so no spur leads nowhere): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, kinds glowcap, wisp, glint, ember, bubble in turn (the map README's donut, alien, star and comet aren't drawn).
